name: The Tale of Two Nekos
storyline:
Family... that is how we live, and expand. Everyone has family... well, not everyone... What would you do, if your family were leaders of an evil empire? would you stop them? Male Protagonist: Dante Sandro and Goddess of the world: Nicole Sandro... they were born by their single biological mother but raised by their step-family... Who was their mother? what happened for the two to be separated?

This is something only Dante will discover, with some help, and hints. Will he be able to reunite with his mother? will he bring the family back? or will there be something else he isn't supposed to know about? something far too sinister?
summary: The Tale of Two Nekoes is a 2D RPG game with 3 stories to play through; Dante's Tale, Akari's Tale, and the Final Tale. This battle system is inspired by the first 6 Final Fantasy games while also having some original aspects as well.
